name: reporting-comms
description: Six skills for turning agent output into something a person actually wants to read. html renders plans, reviews, research, and comparisons as a single self-contained HTML artifact; visual-plan and visual-recap turn text plans and git diffs into interactive documents with diagrams, file maps, and annotated code; recap-table produces before/after and what-changed tables on demand; and writing-clearly-and-concisely and human-writing tighten the prose itself, stripping AI tells, corporate register, and padding.

interface.shortDescription: Make agent output readable by humans
interface.longDescription: Six skills for turning agent output into something a person actually wants to read. html renders plans, reviews, research, and comparisons as a single self-contained HTML artifact; visual-plan and visual-recap turn text plans and git diffs into interactive documents with diagrams, file maps, and annotated code; recap-table produces before/after and what-changed tables on demand; and writing-clearly-and-concisely and human-writing tighten the prose itself, stripping AI tells, corporate register, and padding.
capabilities: Renders reports and reviews as self-contained HTML artifacts
Turns text plans into interactive visual plans with diagrams and file maps
Turns a PR, branch, or diff into a visual recap with annotated changes
Produces before/after and what-changed comparison tables
Rewrites prose to remove AI-generated patterns and padding
